_why: cs #383·AI. (1) Seed 108: the plan re-says L03's rows as 'wake up in the middle of the night' (the settled English) but left the LEGO at 'wake in the middle of the night', so six rows failed containment. The LEGO target and components now say 'wake up' too ('up' is taught earlier), with B01, B03 and U04, the three rows the plan did not touch. B02 (re-cut in recut-374.json to 'hope to wake up…', the 1 vocab failure: hope is no longer taught at 108) is re-said 'expect to wake up in the middle of the night' / رات کے وسط میں جاگنے کی توقع (Platts, s.v. توقع 'expectation'; the plan's own known word). (2) Seed 149's canonical target 'This isn't very difficult, so I hope you'll finish soon.' needs 'hope'. The seed is not touched. The shortest LEGO 'hope' (known امید ہے, the seed's own known word and the old 108 LEGO's, now free since 108 says توقع ہے; Platts, s.v. امید 'hope') is inserted as S0149L02 with 10 rows. Six reuse sentences the course already had (S0149L01's 'I hope' rows and the old S0108L02 'I hope that…' rows). The five S0149L01 rows that said 'I hope' come before that LEGO, so they are re-said without it ('I think that…' / مجھے لگتا ہے کہ as S0072L01U01 and S0163L01, or without the verb), keeping L01 at its BUILD/USE minimum. (3) Six rows in seeds 168-276 said 'I hope' before S0291 re-teaches it. Each seed is validated without the 108/149 overlays, so these are re-said 'I think that…' (taught at S0047/S0163) rather than deleted, because two of them are BUILD rows at their basket's minimum.
